dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual, symmetrical narrowing of the visible body mass from the mid-section toward the posterior peduncle.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Smooth lateral margins without distinct structural bulges or indentations; minor edge irregularities are attributed to water-surface refraction.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Light slate-grey skin tone consistent with a juvenile or sub-adult developmental stage.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low-density, diffuse dark-grey mottling localized across the posterior dorsal surface.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient slopes between localized grey patches and the primary light-grey baseline canvas.
